title: Pay by card
goal: A shopper pays for the basket filled in DM-SHOP-UC01 (whose rule DM-SHOP-UC01-R01 is not cited here).

title: Add an item to the basket
goal: A shopper adds an item, as DM-PAT-CHECKOUT says, within DM-SHOP-DR01. The code calls `DM-SHOP-DR01` by name. It once cited DM-SHOP-DR99.
